instruction: A studio photograph of a cheerleader lineup. In a bright white studio, nine cheerleaders stand side-by-side. From left to right: the brunette cheerleader (R13), the blonde cheerleader (R2), the brunette cheerleader with long straight hair (R8), the dark-haired cheerleader (R14), the curly-haired cheerleader (R1), the purple-haired cheerleader (R7), the short-haired cheerleader (R4), the brown-haired cheerleader (R9), and the wavy-haired cheerleader (R10). They wear white t-shirts with a logo and white skirts, holding orange pom-poms at their hips. Bright, even lighting illuminates the scene.
elements: R1 is the curly-haired cheerleader while R7 is the purple-haired cheerleader, not the reverse
R2 is the blonde cheerleader while R8 is the brunette cheerleader with long straight hair, not the reverse
R14 is the dark-haired cheerleader while R4 is the short-haired cheerleader
the labeled cheerleaders stand side-by-side in a studio cheerleader lineup
the cheerleaders hold orange pom-poms at their hips
the scene is a bright white studio with bright, even lighting

questions.q: Is R2 an onlooker / non-contact person relative to the main hand contact between R1 and R3, rather than R2 being one of the two making contact?
Does R1 stand side-by-side in the cheerleader lineup with the other labeled cheerleaders while holding pom-poms at her hips?
questions.element: R1 participates in the lineup and holds pom-poms at hip level

questions.q: Are R1 and R3 the two people whose hands meet in the contact, rather than R2 joining that hand contact?
